messages:
Sam Turner: Quick note — I'm drafting the onboarding checklist for the new seed region (saturn-2). Want a short troubleshooting section focused on network flapping, GPU preemption patterns, and the common quota gotchas.
Mira Patel: Nice. Can you include a quick command list for smoke checks? I keep forgetting the right nvlink/sgx health probe.
Devin Cho: For GPUs the usual two-liner is `nvidia-smi --query-gpu=index,name,memory.total,memory.used,utilization.gpu --format=csv` and `watch -n 2 kubectl get pods -n inference -o wide`.
Sam Turner: Added a snippet. Thinking of a 3-step flow: 1) infra sanity (vpc/subnets/routes), 2) capacity sanity (GPU counts, drivers), 3) app smoke (k8s pods + sample inference). Thoughts?
Rahul Singh: Sounds good. For infra sanity add a check for SNAT pool exhaustion — last time NAT ephemeral ports caused connect timeouts for large-scale node init.
Mira Patel: Yes — add this, plus an example iperf test for cross-AZ bandwidth: `iperf3 -c <peer> -t 10`. Also remind folks to check security-group egress rules; we lock down 443/80 only by default.
Liz O'Neal: Known issue we should document: certain instance SKU (g4dn.*) in saturn-2 show elevated host reboots with older NV drivers. Recommend pinning driver >= 525. Use this quick snippet:
```
# ensure driver
apt-get update && apt-get install -y nvidia-driver-525
# restart kubelet after driver install
systemctl restart kubelet
```
Devin Cho: Good call. Also capture the recommended kubelet eviction thresholds for spot-heavy pools: `--eviction-hard=memory.available<200Mi,nodefs.available<10%`.
Sam Turner: I'm writing a short troubleshooting matrix: symptom -> likely cause -> quick mitigation. Example:
- Pods stuck Pending -> insufficient GPU capacity in AZ -> mitigation: scale node-group + fallback to secondary AZ
- High pod restarts on spot nodes -> frequent preemptions -> mitigation: use instance-flex with on-demand fallback or add more reserved instances
Mira Patel: Add an entry for TLS cert provisioning delays — we've had ACME rate limiting when many certs requested at once. Suggest a staggered rollout and pre-warmed cert manager job.
ops-bot: region-provision: saturn-2 resources created: vpc-17fd, subnet-a/b/c, route-table-17fd. See infra console at https://infra.redwood.example/regions/saturn-2
Sam Turner: Perfect. Can someone QA the runbook doc and the troubleshooting matrix? I want this to be short and actionable — one-page checklist + triage table.
Rahul Singh: I'll take infra sanity and SNAT section.
Liz O'Neal: I'll verify GPU driver notes and add a link to the internal driver compatibility matrix.
Devin Cho: I'll validate the k8s smoke steps and add a small python snippet to run a quick inference against the canary model.
Mira Patel: I'll run through the ACME/tls scenario and add the stagger job suggestion.
Sam Turner: Great — target to merge runbook updates by EOD Friday. If anyone hits anything weird when testing, paste logs here. :thumbsup:
Devin Cho: One more tiny checklist item — document the quota request template for the cloud console (region, SKU, desired cores, justification). Saves us time.
Sam Turner: Added. Thanks team. :raised_hands:
